title: Export items for backup or bulk update (reformat before any re-import)
summary: Writes lightspeed-csv (Type, Name, Category, Price, Description, Modifier Groups, Available) for handoff and diffing, with the K-Series warnings that matter: some exported columns are not valid for re-import, and updates cannot be reversed.

steps.title: Re-format before re-import and never trust the automatic mapping
steps.instructions: Back Office export columns are not all import-safe; SKU and Type must be mapped by hand on the import screen, and unused optional columns should be deleted rather than left blank.

steps.title: Accept that updates cannot be reversed and items cannot be deleted
steps.instructions: Retirement here means disable, not delete; there is no Undo Catalogue. Confirm the accounting group spelling too - a near-miss silently creates a duplicate with its own tax and production-center settings.
